name: Abi Adeyoola
text: MF Project Solutions delivered exceptional service for my house snag and resnag. They were punctual, professional, and incredibly detail-oriented. The report was thorough, with clear pictures highlighting every issue. They even flagged things I hadn't noticed myself. I will highly recommend them for anyone needing snagging services; they offered me truly excellent service all around.
highlight: The report was thorough, with clear pictures highlighting every issue.
